description: Retirement Monte Carlo simulator — Monte Carlo retirement and savings simulator (seeded, reproducible): success rate (never running out), verdict HIGH_CONFIDENCE / LIKELY / UNCERTAIN / UNLIKELY, ending-balance percentiles in nominal and today's dollars, depletion year stats, year-by-year 10th/50th/90th percentile path, and the largest inflation-adjusted withdrawal with 90% success. Params: balance= and years= (1-100), withdrawal= annual in today's dollars (0 for pure saving); optional withdrawal_start= year, contribution= annual, contribution_years=, return= mean annual % (default 7), volatility= % (default 15), inflation= % (default 2.5), fee= annual %, sims= (100-2000), seed=, target= real-dollar goal for probability of reaching it. Not financial advice. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_monte_carlo
